content.description: Planet Mojo is an ecosystem of interconnected games created by Mystic Moose, set on a mysterious alien planet with an evolving narrative. Players assemble customized teams of fantastical creatures to compete across a suite of eSports and PvP titles. The long-term vision is a sustainable, expanding catalog of games for the next generation of gamers, with player ownership of in-game assets and a voice in the project’s future direction.
